method_findings: Use the accepted contraction to turn a continuous full integral residual into X error.
A C1-in-time reconstruction is useful but does not automatically supply radial derivative or C3 error bounds.
External scalar wave L-infinity(L2) displacement estimates do not bound the shell trace/X norm.
Keep all approximate input, reconstruction, projection and mesh-transfer defects in one consistent budget.
Convert LTZ measure normalization and retain required TT sectors.
Fixed-gauge scalar mean remains a numerical diagnostic; invariant observation requires geometric identification and its own estimate.
provenance_scope: Raw source retrievals/search/access records are retained locally and excluded from this public supplement. The ledger provides primary links and checked versions/anchors, not a claim of complete proof audit or external novelty.
